scope: Source and proof review of the three retained runtime files; not formal verification or universal input coverage.
preservation_checks: The ordinary recover_factored_zero calls select const false; their total-degree guard and absence of unit-circle residual reduction remain.
The late retry runs only when the original extended expansion returns None. It reuses the same recognizer, quotient memo, inverse witnesses, cancellation signal and remaining node/work counters.
Both late distribution strategies require a common admitted polynomial factor before any residual proof. The preserved-summand fallback does not refund the distributed attempt.

Each nonconstant factor is admitted by the existing quotient expansion/projection. Its inverse obligations are not skipped when another factor scales to zero. The existing checked Real input-domain contract still applies.

Factoring uses exact polynomial equality. Removing a common factor to prove C*0 needs no nonzero assumption about C. Only an empty residual, directly or after registered unit-circle reduction, returns zero.
The final entry point still checks cancellation before publishing the exact sign; declines are not retained as negative mathematical facts.

The five new scalar tests preserve all old assertions, including the existing degree14decline. The three public tests retain distinct binary64/decimal inputs and strengthen original empty continuation.
oracle_scope: The cube oracle separately checks strict certainty, closed manifold, bounded vertices, outward support-plane triangles and exact unit volume. Whole-workflow control artifacts preserve exact values/indices/receipts but are not an independent proof of every baseline represented set.
cost_scope: All64scalar and4workflow protected simultaneous upper bounds exceed1 in their separate families. Native results cannot support a speedup/nonregression claim. Allocation sequence comparisons cover every paired batch.
